This was my first purchase from Nykaa, and it has been extremely disappointing. The website and SMS updates showed that my order was successfully delivered, but I never actually received the package.

This false delivery status caused a lot of confusion and inconvenience, as there was no proper proof of delivery or any attempt to contact me.

When I reached out to customer support, the response was slow and not very helpful, which made the situation even more frustrating. In comparison, platforms like Amazon and Flipkart usually provide accurate tracking, proper delivery confirmation, and responsive customer support, which builds customer trust over time.

Nykaa seriously needs to learn from such platforms on how a complete e-commerce ecosystem should functionfrom logistics to communication and customer service. Because of this experience, I have lost trust in their service and do not plan to purchase anything from this company again.

If such issues continue, many customers may start avoiding the platform altogether. I would also advise my fellow citizens to be cautious when ordering, as accurate tracking and reliable delivery are essential for online shopping.
